definition: [ רְדִיד ] noun [masculine] wide wrapper, or large veil ( ᵑ7 Jer רְדִידָא (especially for Hebrew צָעִיף ); Syriac apparently veil ; Arabic is wrapper ); — suffix רְדִידִי Song 5:7 plural דָרְדִידִים Isa 3:23 (in list of women's finery).
